trackertips.command.test.player_only: [TrackerTips] This command can only be run by a player.
trackertips.hint.welcome.title: Welcome!
trackertips.hint.welcome.text: Edit config/trackertips to customize your hints.
trackertips.gui.title: TrackerTips
trackertips.gui.commands.description: Reload the server-side TrackerTips event definitions.
trackertips.gui.usage.title: TrackerTips usage
trackertips.gui.usage.line1: Event files are stored in config/trackertips/hints/.
trackertips.gui.usage.line2: Edit an event through Cloth Config, then reload the configuration.
trackertips.gui.usage.line3: The event editor keeps the original JSON structure.
trackertips.gui.event.title: Title JSON
trackertips.gui.event.name: File name
trackertips.gui.reload_hint: Use “Reload Configuration” to apply server-side events after saving.
trackertips.gui.event.invalid_json: Invalid JSON; this field was not saved.
trackertips.gui.general_hint: Numeric values are clamped to their allowed range when saved.
trackertips.gui.quit.confirm.title: Unsaved Changes
trackertips.gui.quit.confirm.warning: You have unsaved TrackerTips changes. Discard them?
trackertips.gui.usage.theme_line: Each event can select a notification theme with its theme field. Themes live in config/trackertips/themes/.
trackertips.gui.theme.name: Theme Name
trackertips.gui.event.structure.tooltip: The structure id the player must be standing inside (e.g. minecraft:village_plains). Checked periodically, not event-driven.
trackertips.gui.enable.tooltip: Master switch for the mod's hint popups. Does not affect commands.
trackertips.gui.offset_x.tooltip: Horizontal distance, in pixels, from the bottom-left corner of the screen.
trackertips.gui.offset_y.tooltip: Vertical distance, in pixels, from the bottom of the screen.
trackertips.gui.max_width.tooltip: Maximum width, in pixels, of a hint panel before its text wraps.
trackertips.gui.max_hints.tooltip: Maximum number of hint popups shown on screen at the same time.
trackertips.gui.fade_in.tooltip: How many ticks a hint takes to fade/slide fully into view.
trackertips.gui.fade_out.tooltip: How many ticks a hint takes to fade/slide fully out of view before disappearing.
trackertips.gui.debug.tooltip: Logs extra diagnostic information about trigger checks to the console/log file.
trackertips.gui.check_interval.tooltip: How often, in ticks, state-based triggers (not tied to a specific event) are re-checked for every online player.
trackertips.gui.default_duration.tooltip: Fallback duration, in ticks, used when an event doesn't specify its own "duration". -1 means persistent.
trackertips.gui.shortcut_command.tooltip: When enabled, players can type /tt instead of the full /trackertips command. Takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
trackertips.gui.event.id.tooltip: This event's unique, mod-namespaced identifier (e.g. mymod:welcome). Used by chains and /trackertips test to reference it.
trackertips.gui.event.once.tooltip: If enabled, this hint can trigger at most once per player (equivalent to max_times: 1 unless overridden).
trackertips.gui.event.priority.tooltip: Controls stacking order when multiple hints are visible at once; higher values render closer to the bottom of the stack.
trackertips.gui.event.cooldown.tooltip: Ticks that must pass after this hint is shown before it can trigger again for the same player.
trackertips.gui.event.duration.tooltip: How long the popup stays visible, in ticks. Use -1 for a persistent hint tied to a state trigger (e.g. health_below).
trackertips.gui.event.sound.tooltip: Sound event id to play when this hint appears (e.g. minecraft:block.note_block.pling). Leave blank for no sound.
trackertips.gui.event.pitch.tooltip: Playback pitch for the sound above, from 0.5 (low) to 2.0 (high). 1.0 is normal pitch.
trackertips.gui.event.icon.tooltip: Item id shown as this hint's icon (e.g. minecraft:diamond). Leave blank for no icon.
trackertips.gui.event.max_times.tooltip: Maximum number of times this hint can trigger per player, across their whole save. 0 means unlimited.
trackertips.gui.event.theme.tooltip: The theme id used to style this hint's popup (colors, animation, etc.). Themes live in config/trackertips/themes/.
trackertips.gui.event.title_component.to: The popup's bold title line. Optional - leave the text/translation key blank to show no title.
trackertips.gui.event.text_component.too: One line of the popup's body text. Multiple text components are shown stacked, in order.
trackertips.gui.event.component_kind.too: "Plain Text" uses the value below verbatim; "Translation Key" looks it up in the active language file, so it can be localized.
trackertips.gui.event.component_value.to: The literal text, or the translation key, depending on the Component Type selected above.
trackertips.gui.event.component_color.to: A named Minecraft chat color (e.g. gold, aqua, red) or a hex code. Leave blank to use the theme's default color.
trackertips.gui.event.component_bold.too: Renders this line in bold text.
trackertips.gui.event.component_italic.t: Renders this line in italic text.
trackertips.gui.event.require.tooltip: "All" requires every trigger below to be satisfied at once; "Any" fires as soon as a single one is.
trackertips.gui.event.trigger_type.toolt: What kind of condition this trigger checks. Changing this after saving once requires reopening the editor to edit the new type's fields.
trackertips.gui.event.accent.tooltip: A 6-digit hex color (no #) used as this hint's accent/highlight color, e.g. F2C14E.
trackertips.gui.event.game_time_mode.too: "After"/"Before" compare against a single time value; "In Range" requires the current day-time to fall between Time and End Time.
trackertips.gui.event.time.tooltip: A day-time value in ticks (0-24000). See the Time Mode field for how it's used.
trackertips.gui.event.end_time.tooltip: Only used when Time Mode is "In Range": the end of the time window, in ticks.
trackertips.gui.event.potion_mode.toolti: "When Added"/"When Removed" fire once on that event; "While Active" is a persistent state trigger for the effect's whole duration.
trackertips.gui.event.effect.tooltip: The potion/mob effect id to match, e.g. minecraft:speed.
trackertips.gui.event.amplifier_min.tool: Minimum effect amplifier (0 = level I) required to match. Higher amplifiers still match.
trackertips.gui.event.item.tooltip: The item id to match, e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot.
trackertips.gui.event.count.tooltip: The minimum quantity required to match.
trackertips.gui.event.advancement_mode.t: "Advancement Done" fires once when earned; "Advancement State" is a persistent trigger that stays true while it remains earned.
trackertips.gui.event.dimension.tooltip: The dimension id the player must be in, e.g. minecraft:the_nether.
trackertips.gui.event.health.tooltip: Triggers while the player's health is at or below this value (in half-hearts).
trackertips.gui.event.entity.tooltip: The entity type id that must be killed, e.g. minecraft:zombie.
trackertips.gui.event.block.tooltip: The block id that must be mined, e.g. minecraft:diamond_ore.
trackertips.gui.event.chain_enabled.tool: When enabled, this hint listens for one more trigger after being shown, then dismisses itself or shows another hint once it matches.
trackertips.gui.event.chain_action.toolt: What happens once the chain trigger below matches: dismiss this popup, or hide it and show another hint in its place.
trackertips.gui.event.chain_next.tooltip: The id of the hint to show next. Only used when Chain Action is "Show Next Hint".
trackertips.gui.theme.id.tooltip: This theme's unique id. Fixed for existing themes; set once when a new theme is created.
trackertips.gui.theme.name.tooltip: Display name shown in the Themes list and the theme editor's title.
trackertips.gui.theme.title_color.toolti: Default color for the title line, used when an event's title doesn't set its own color.
trackertips.gui.theme.text_color.tooltip: Default color for body text lines, used when an event's text doesn't set its own color.
trackertips.gui.theme.border_width.toolt: Thickness, in pixels, of the popup card's border. 0 disables the border.
trackertips.gui.theme.corner_radius.tool: Corner rounding radius, in pixels, of the popup card.
trackertips.gui.theme.padding.tooltip: Inner padding, in pixels, between the popup card's edge and its content.
trackertips.gui.theme.card_animation.typ: How the popup card itself animates in/out: none, fade, slide, or slide up.
trackertips.gui.theme.card_animation.dur: How many ticks the card's animation takes to complete.
trackertips.gui.theme.card_animation.del: Ticks to wait before the card's animation begins.
trackertips.gui.theme.text_animation.typ: How the text inside the card animates in/out, independent of the card's own animation.
trackertips.gui.theme.text_animation.dur: How many ticks the text's animation takes to complete.
trackertips.gui.theme.text_animation.del: Ticks to wait before the text's animation begins.
